title: Quantifying Meaning with SCAPE-T: Semantic Complexity from Encoder-Only Transformer Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.33441v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated semantic complexity estimation remains underexplored in NLP, despite important applications in linguistics and interpretability. This paper defines semantic complexity as the code length required to uniquely specify a text's semantic meaning, and operationalises it via SCAPE-T, an attention-derived metric based on encoder-only transformers. Existing measures either model reader effort (readability, lexical difficulty), which correlates with surface features (word length, syntax), or quantify surface features directly (type-token ratio, word frequency). SCAPE-T targets semantic integration directly by combining three submetrics: (i) inverse-weighted self-focus (token-to-self), (ii) CLS focus (token-to-CLS), and (iii) inter-head redundancy (cosine similarity across heads), using layer-weighted aggregation; data-driven learning is confined to hyperparameter tuning for calibration. Development uses philosophical prose vs. MCTest

translated_title: 用SCAPE-T量化意义：基于编码器专用Transformer注意力的语义复杂度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.33441v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：自动语义复杂度估计在自然语言处理（NLP）领域仍未得到充分探索，尽管其在语言学和可解释性方面具有重要应用。本文将语义复杂度定义为唯一指定文本语义含义所需的编码长度，并通过SCAPE-T对其进行操作化实现——这是一种基于编码器专用transformer、由注意力机制派生的指标。现有度量方法要么对读者付出的认知努力进行建模（如可读性、词汇难度），这类方法与表层特征（词长、句法）相关；要么直接量化表层特征（如类符-形符比、词频）。SCAPE-T则直接针对语义整合，结合三个子指标：（i）逆加权的自我聚焦（词元到自身）、（ii）CLS聚焦（词元到CLS）、（iii）头间冗余度（跨注意力头的余弦相似度），并采用层加权聚合；数据驱动的学习仅限于用于校准的超参数调整。开发过程使用哲学散文与MCTest……
tldr: 本文提出SCAPE-T，一种基于编码器Transformer注意力机制的语义复杂度度量方法，将语义复杂度定义为唯一指定文本语义所需的编码长度，通过自我聚焦、CLS聚焦和头间冗余度三个子指标直接量化语义整合，且无需数据驱动训练。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SCAPE-T, an attention-derived metric based on encoder-only transformers that quantifies semantic complexity as the code length required to uniquely specify a text's meaning, combining self-focus, CLS focus, and inter-head redundancy submetrics to directly capture semantic integration without data-driven training.
